endpoints.title: Raid Bosses
endpoints.summary: Every current raid boss, grouped by raid tier.
endpoints.structure: An object keyed by the tier name shown on Leek Duck (for example "5-Star Raids" or "Mega Raids"). Each value is a list of raid boss objects. Shadow raid bosses share their tier's list and are marked with is_shadow.

fields.name: name
fields.description: The Pokémon's name. Shadow bosses are named "Shadow …".

fields.name: tier
fields.description: The tier number (for example 5), or the tier name when it has no number (for example "Mega Raids").

fields.name: is_shadow
fields.description: true for a Shadow Raid boss.

fields.name: shiny_available
fields.description: true if the boss can be shiny.

fields.name: cp_range
fields.description: Catch CP range as { min, max }, or null when Leek Duck does not list one.

fields.name: boosted_cp_range
fields.description: Weather-boosted catch CP range as { min, max }, or null when not listed.

fields.name: types
fields.description: The Pokémon's types, for example ["Water", "Dragon"].

fields.name: asset_url
fields.description: URL of the Pokémon's image.

endpoints.title: Events
endpoints.summary: Current and upcoming in-game events, grouped by category.
endpoints.structure: An object keyed by event category (for example "Raid Hour" or "Community Day"). Each value is a list of event objects. Events move to the yearly archives after they end.

fields.name: title
fields.description: The event's name.

fields.name: category
fields.description: The event's category; always matches the key it is listed under.

fields.name: is_local_time
fields.description: true if the event runs at the same local time in every timezone.

fields.name: start_time
fields.description: Unix time for global events, or a timezone-naive ISO 8601 string (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS) for local-time events.

fields.name: end_time
fields.description: Same format as start_time.

fields.name: article_url
fields.description: The event's Leek Duck article. Unique per event.

fields.name: banner_url
fields.description: URL of the event's banner image.

fields.name: description
fields.description: The event description; may span several lines.

fields.name: details
fields.description: Event sections keyed by the section name on the event page, such as bonuses, features, spawns, eggs, raids, shiny, moves, or research. Only sections the page has are present.

fields.name: details.bonuses
fields.description: Event bonuses as plain text.

fields.name: details.<section>
fields.description: Every other section is a list of Pokémon objects: { name, asset_url, shiny_available }. asset_url may be null.

notes: Events whose times are still "to be announced" are omitted until both times are published, so start_time and end_time are always set.
An event whose page cannot be read completely is omitted until a later update reads it successfully.

endpoints.title: Event Archives
endpoints.summary: Events that have ended, one file per year.
endpoints.structure: Same shape and fields as events.json. Events are filed under the year they ended.

fields.name: (all event fields)
fields.description: As in events.json, with the exception below.

fields.name: description
fields.description: Absent for the few events whose Leek Duck page no longer exists; fall back to title.

notes: Archiving began on September 19, 2025. Events that ended earlier are included only if they were still listed then, so earlier coverage is partial.
Archives were rebuilt from their source pages on August 10, 2026, so every record uses the current schema. Identity, category, banner, and times are never altered by a rebuild.
manifest.json lists the archive years that exist.

endpoints.title: Field Research
endpoints.summary: Current Field Research tasks and their possible rewards.
endpoints.structure: An object keyed by task category (for example "Catching Tasks"). Each value is a list of task objects.

fields.name: task
fields.description: The task's description.

fields.name: rewards
fields.description: The possible rewards for the task.

fields.name: rewards[].type
fields.description: "encounter", "item", or "resource".

fields.name: rewards[].name
fields.description: The Pokémon or item name.

fields.name: rewards[].shiny_available
fields.description: Encounters only: true if the Pokémon can be shiny.

fields.name: rewards[].cp_range
fields.description: Encounters only: CP range as { min, max }, or null when not listed.

fields.name: rewards[].quantity
fields.description: Items and resources only: how many are rewarded.

fields.name: rewards[].asset_url
fields.description: URL of the reward's image.

endpoints.title: Team GO Rocket Lineups
endpoints.summary: Current lineups for Team GO Rocket leaders and grunts.
endpoints.structure: An object keyed by the member's name (for example "Giovanni" or "Fire-type Female Grunt"). Each value is a list of lineup slots.

fields.name: slot
fields.description: Position in the lineup: 1, 2, or 3.

fields.name: is_encounter
fields.description: true if the Pokémon in this slot can be caught after the battle.

fields.name: pokemons
fields.description: The possible Pokémon for the slot: { name, shiny_available, asset_url }. asset_url may be null.

endpoints.title: Egg Pool
endpoints.summary: Pokémon currently hatching from each kind of egg.
endpoints.structure: An object keyed by egg group (for example "2 km Eggs" or "7 km Eggs (From Friend Gifts)"). Each value is a list of Pokémon objects.

fields.name: name
fields.description: The Pokémon's name.

fields.name: hatch_distance
fields.description: Hatch distance in kilometers, or null if the group name has none.

fields.name: rarity_tier
fields.description: Hatch rarity from 1 (most common) to 5 (rarest); absent when Leek Duck does not show one.

fields.name: shiny_available
fields.description: true if the Pokémon can be shiny.

fields.name: asset_url
fields.description: URL of the Pokémon's image.

endpoints.title: Manifest
endpoints.summary: Every published file with its checksum and when its content last changed.
endpoints.structure: An object with a files key, mapping each file's path (for example "archives/archive_2026.json") to its details.

fields.name: files.<path>.updated_at
fields.description: When the file's content last changed, as UTC ISO 8601 (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ).

fields.name: files.<path>.sha256
fields.description: SHA-256 of the file, for cheap change detection.

fields.name: files.<path>.size
fields.description: File size in bytes.

entries: raid_bosses.json: regular bosses are listed again. Shadow bosses had been overwriting them; both now share their tier's list, with a new is_shadow field.
rocket_lineups.json: member names use normal spaces instead of non-breaking spaces.
events.json: an event whose page cannot be read completely is omitted instead of blocking the whole update.
Added manifest.json, and the data is now served from pokelitee.github.io. The raw.githubusercontent.com URLs keep working.
Archives rebuilt from their source pages: Pokémon detail sections are Pokémon objects throughout, and description is optional in archives.
Event detail sections other than bonuses changed from Pokémon name strings to Pokémon objects.
